item.title: Writing a Mutex in C: Atomics and x86
item.description:
Mutex, What is it?

Example 1

Imagine two people updating the same number on a whiteboard. The number is 0 and both have to increment it by 1.

The answer should be 2. But what if both read 0 before either writes anything? Both calculate 1. Both write 1.

So the important thing is not just how we increment the number. It is who gets to update it right now.

item.title: Writing ARP From Scratch and My Learnings
item.description:
What this blog covers and expects you to know.

Expectations

  • Know what ethernet frame is like.
  • Know how to use wireshark.
  • endianness

Covers

  • Usage of libc on rust

What is it and why do we need it?

Address Resolution Protocol is used to create a mapping between layer 2(Hardware Address) i.e. Mac Address and layer 3 Address(IP Address). Even though it is specifically used for IP. It is designed to be completely decoupled to the layer 3 protocol.
